expectations.text: A subject-mined glyph device is named (not a stock category glyph); the stated device relates to cashflow/ledger subject matter

expectations.text: At least three takes exist on disk spanning Engine A (hand-authored SVG), Engine B (Arrow vector SVG), and Engine C (raster) — or a missing engine is explicitly named as a user-agreed deviation in the output

summary.notes: 6/6, and every pass is backed by on-disk evidence including a byte-identical regeneration of the master from its build script and a live fidelity.py structure PASS; the audit's quantitative claims spot-checked true (e.g. B's 2:1 viewBox). None of the passes are vacuous.
